newsitem.title: CHINA: China fears strong yen to increase repayment costs.
newsitem.headline: China fears strong yen to increase repayment costs.

text.p: Chinese Premier Li Peng told visiting Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka on Wednesday that a strengthening of the yen would add to China's loan repayment burden.
Due to China's high level of yen-denominated loans any strengthening of the yen would result in difficulties for China, a Japanese finance official quoted Li as saying in his talks with Mitsuzuka.
The Export-Import Bank of Japan agreed on Wednesday to extend $700 million in untied loans to China.
Mitsuzuka and Li also agreed in their talks that currency stability was important, the Japanese official said.
The two sides announced no concrete steps but earlier a Japanese official said Tokyo had offered to cooperate with China to maintain stability in international financial markets.
